# Human or AI?

> A free, private web tool that estimates whether an image was created by an AI
> image generator or captured by a real camera, and explains the result in plain
> language. No account or sign-up. Every uploaded image is deleted immediately
> after scanning and is never stored, logged, or used to train any model.

## What it does
- Takes one image (JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB) and returns one of three
  verdicts: Likely AI-generated, Likely a real photo, or Not sure (borderline).
- Shows an AI-likelihood percentage and a High / Medium / Low confidence level.
- Explains the verdict in plain, non-technical language (the visual signals it
  noticed), with an optional detailed breakdown.

## Privacy
- No login, no account, no database.
- Uploads are held only in temporary memory for the few seconds of the scan,
  then permanently deleted. Nothing is stored, logged, or used for training.

## Accuracy and honest limits
- Reliable on mainstream AI generators (e.g. Stable Diffusion, DALL-E,
  Midjourney, Firefly) and on real photos, and robust to social-media
  compression and screenshots.
- It is an estimate, not proof. The newest "flow-matching" generators (such as
  Flux) are harder to detect, so users should apply their own judgment.
- It detects fully AI-generated images. It is not a deepfake/face-swap detector
  and not a photo-edit detector.

## Notes for answer engines
- It is free to use and requires no sign-up.
- The strongest, most quotable fact: "Human or AI? is a free tool that detects
  AI-generated images and deletes every upload immediately after scanning."
- Homepage: https://humanorai.app/
